result:
I added a per-phase setting, "Membros do comitê podem ver notas individuais dos outros membros". When it's on, a committee member sees the other members' individual forms, read-only. It defaults to off, so existing phases behave as before. I haven't run the migration or any tests.

- **Setting:** a new boolean column `committee_can_see_members` on `admission_phases`, added through a new migration. I also updated `db/schema.rb` by hand (version bumped to `2024_12_10_000000`). It appears in the phase create and edit form with a pt-BR label.
- **Behaviour:** the change is in `app/models/admissions/admission_phase.rb`. Previously a committee user only got their own member form. With the setting on, other members' forms are included but can't be edited. Their own form and the other forms behave as before.

You'll need to run `rails db:migrate` before this works.
